group_1.textLeft: Good morning, Big Bro Haruto!

group_1.textRight: Morning, Akari. You're up earlier than usual.

group_1.textLeft: Hotaru has class duty today, so I'm off to wake@her up earlier than normal.

group_1.textRight: So that's why you're so full of spirit.

group_1.textLeft: Guess so.
(...What I said isn't a lie,)
(but the main reason I'm so motivated)
(is because Hotaru leaves her house early@on class duty days,)
(so I get to be together with Big Bro Haruto@on his way to school)
(by Hotaru's house for his morning club training.)
...Um, big bro, the tie on your uniform is crooked.
You mind crouching a bit so I can fix it?

group_1.textRight: [chara:800400:effect_emotion_surprise_0][se:7226_shock]Oh—@It's 'cause I was in such a hurry...

group_1.textLeft: There, fixed it.

group_1.textRight: Thanks. You really are a reliable one, Akari.
Since I'm like your older brother,
I oughta become more reliable too...

group_1.textLeft: (Still treating me like a younger sister...)
(Even if you've been watching over me@since the moment I was born,)
(I wish you'd like me as a girl, not a younger sister.)
(I've put so much into appealing to you,)
(so it'd be nice if you noticed a little...)
(...The wall between five years is just that thick,@isn't it.)
(If we were in the same grade, we could be going@to our clubs together.)
...Big Bro Haruto, clubs are fun, aren't they?

group_1.textRight: You're pretty curious about club activities, huh?

group_1.textLeft: Because, Big Bro Haruto, you've been doing lots@of club activities lately.

group_1.textRight: When I think it's now or never I just get fired up.

group_1.textLeft: (Well, that's true...)
(You are following Uncle's footsteps)
(since you have to lead the Nikaido group,)
(so I do understand why you want to do@what you do while you still can.)
(...It's because of that)
(I get so lonely spending less time with my big bro,@though.)

group_1.textRight: Though I'm going to have to take a day off from@today's after-school activities...

group_1.textLeft: Why?

group_1.textRight: Father's got stuff for me to do, so he told me@I have to hurry on back.

group_1.textLeft: Uncle did? Is it to help the company?

group_1.textRight: Uhh...he didn't really give me the details.
Some kinda "good prospects" for me apparently@though...
He's been in some wacky mystery mood since@he got back from dinner last night.

group_1.textLeft: (...Huh? Come home early—)
Maybe we could walk home together today?

group_1.textRight: Fine with me, but would Yura-senpai be okay?

group_1.textLeft: She's fine!
Even Hotaru should be independent@from time to time!
So Big Bro Haruto, will you go home with me?

group_1.textRight: When class is over I'll come meet you@at your classroom, okay?

group_1.textLeft: Yeah—!
[chara:305701:effect_emotion_joy_0][se:7222_happy](Scooore!)
